items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I know you played quite a bit with Fazola in the very, some of your last, Fazola's last records almost were with you.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. He was on the sort of Rapolo style, same style.

Yeah. I know you played quite a bit with Fazola in the very, some of your last, Fazola's last records almost were with you. There was 1940 records. Mm-hmm. And I know you once said he was your favorite clarinetist at that period. How did he compare with Rapolo, for instance?

He compared very much with Rapolo. In fact, I think he got a better sound than Rapolo and a better musician. He was a studied musician. Yeah, that's right. He knew his chords and everything. That helps out quite a bit. I wish I knew mine.
